summary_en: Introduces two scalar indices for sound-speed-profile nonlinearity and connects them quantitatively to two-way phase errors, inter-ping coherence loss, and synthetic-aperture acoustic image degradation. Ray-based simulations show strong coherence collapse as SSP curvature increases, providing a practical criterion for validating propagation assumptions and motivating environment-aware phase compensation in SAS and related coherent ultrasonic imaging systems.

summary_en: Develops a higher-accuracy image-formation pipeline for multireceiver synthetic aperture sonar by modeling the double-trip slant-range error as a function of target range, bearing angle, and transmitter-receiver baseline. The method compensates the resulting Doppler phase and residual migration, forms quasi-monostatic data, and applies a modified range migration algorithm; simulation and experimental results report improved focusing quality over conventional approximations.
